name: hackernews
description: Let your agent read Hacker News: search stories and comments, read a thread, check an account and a site's history, and watch a launch. Read only, no account needed.

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Hacker News
examples: Has our site been posted to Hacker News before, and how did it do?
Is my Hacker News account ready for a Show HN?
Watch our Show HN and tell me about new comments since you last looked

tools.name: hn_search
tools.description: Search Hacker News stories or comments through Algolia, with no key. Bare words are quoted so Algolia does not fuzz them; filter by kind, author, dates, points and comments. Returns one line per hit and the hit estimate.

tools.name: hn_item
tools.description: Read one item: a story's points, comments, flags, link and text, and its comment tree with top-level comments in Hacker News's own rank order.

tools.name: hn_user
tools.description: Read an account for a launch preflight: age, karma, story, comment and Show HN counts, and its Show HNs from the last year.

tools.name: hn_front
tools.description: Read a live list (top, new, best, show, ask, job) with rank positions, or find where one item ranks on it right now.

tools.name: hn_domain
tools.description: Every story submitted for a domain or one page, newest first, with points and comments: has this been posted before.

tools.name: hn_thread_since
tools.description: One story's points, comments and rank now, and the comments posted after a cursor, oldest first; pass the returned cursor next time.
